title: registration_request
description: A request to register. A request, not a registration. registration_type is private, group or class. The requester is the person filling it in; participants are everyone else being trained (for a gift, the recipient); attendee_count is the total number of people wanting seats; has_minors_present says whether anyone under 18 will be on site, and age_band (child, teen, adult) can mark the requester and each participant. Private and group need a duration and location type. A class request either picks a scheduled class (scheduled_class_id) or says none fit (no_class_fits). Fields marked readOnly are set by the server only: the endpoint rejects any submission that includes one, then adds them before storing. x_server_required lists the readOnly fields every stored record must have. The class seat snapshot fields (target and maximum capacity, registered, seats available up to the maximum) are required only when scheduled_class_id is present and must be absent otherwise (endpoint rule).

registration_type.description: Which kind of request this is: private (one person, a couple or a family), group (a leader bringing a network of people) or class (a seat in a scheduled class, or a request for one). Decides which other fields apply. Required.

attendee_count.description: The TOTAL number of people wanting seats, including the requester when attending. 1 to 50. Required on every type. Names in participants (plus the requester if attending) must not exceed it, but the count may be higher than the names given.

idempotency_key.description: A UUID the browser creates once per submission. If the same key arrives again (double tap, retry after a network failure) the endpoint returns the original result and creates nothing. Required.

first_name.description: The requester's first name. The requester is the person filling in the form, who may or may not be attending. Required. Personal data.

last_name.description: The requester's last name. Required. Personal data.

email.description: The requester's email address. The server trims and lowercases it before validating and before matching repeats. Required. Personal data.

phone.description: The requester's phone number, free text up to 40 characters. Optional. Personal data.

street_address.description: The requester's street address. Matters mainly when the session is at their home. Optional. Personal data.

referrer_first_name.description: First name of the person who referred the requester. Optional. Third-party personal data: store it, but do not contact that person without their say-so.

referrer_last_name.description: Last name of the person who referred the requester. Optional. Third-party personal data.

referrer_email.description: Email of the person who referred the requester. Optional. Third-party personal data: never used to contact them without their say-so.

presented_cost_cents.description: The price shown to the visitor, in US cents. Read together with presented_cost_basis: per_session is the whole session (private and group), per_person is each attendee (class).

presented_cost_basis.description: What the presented price covers: per_session is the whole session (private and group are a flat session price); per_person is each attendee (a class seat). Required alongside presented_cost_cents.

duration_minutes_requested.description: How long a private or group session should be, in minutes (15 to 600). Required for private and group; not allowed on a class request, because the class sets its own length.

requested_date.description: A date that could work (YYYY-MM-DD, Mountain time, today or later). Optional. For a "none fit" class request this is part of the demand signal.

alternate_requested_date.description: A second date that could work (YYYY-MM-DD, today or later). Optional.

requested_time_of_day.description: Best time of day: morning, afternoon or evening. Optional.

has_downloaded_ai_app.description: Whether the requester has downloaded an AI app on a phone or computer. Optional background for planning the session.

has_used_ai_online.description: Whether the requester has used AI on a website. Optional background.

proficiency.description: How comfortable the requester is with AI today, 1 (never tried it) to 10 (uses it every day). Optional. The scale (1 to 10 here, 1 to 5 on the old form) is still an open decision.

favorite_ai.description: The AI product the requester likes best, free text. Optional.

ai_name.description: What the requester calls, or would call, their AI assistant. Optional.

is_requester_attending.description: Whether the requester will take part. False for a gift or when arranging for others; then participants must list at least one person. Required.

participants.description: Everyone else being trained (up to 50). For a gift the recipient is a participant; for a couple, the spouse. Each person needs a first name or a last name (one is enough), plus an optional email and age_band. Personal data about people other than the requester: collect the minimum, and do not contact them without the requester's say-so.

first_name.description: First name of this person. A first or last name is required (one is enough).

last_name.description: Last name of this person. A first or last name is required (one is enough).

email.description: Optional email for this person. Not used to contact them without the requester's say-so.

age_band.description: Optional age group: child, teen or adult. A child or teen means has_minors_present must be true.

location_type.description: Where a private or group session should happen: home (a private home) or off_site (a library, cafe, hall, office). Required for private and group; not allowed on a class request.

preferred_location.description: Where the requester would like it, in their own words (a town, an area, a venue idea). Used by private, group and class ("none fit") requests. Optional.

what_they_want.description: In the requester's words: what they would love to do with AI. Free text up to 2000 characters. The best signal of what a person cares about. Optional.

preferred_times.description: Anything else about timing, free text (for example "weekday mornings, not Fridays"). Optional.

is_gift.description: True when the request is a gift. The recipient is listed in participants, so there are no separate recipient fields.

devices.description: Devices the requester or their group would bring: iphone, android_phone, tablet, windows_laptop, mac_laptop, other (up to 6, no repeats). Optional.

has_paid_ai_account.description: Whether the requester pays for an AI account. Optional background.

how_heard.description: How the requester heard about the workshop, free text. Optional.

promotion_code.description: An optional code carried in from a promotion link, so promotions can be measured against requests. Matches a promotion record's code.

preferred_contact_method.description: How the requester prefers to be contacted: email or phone. Optional.

consent_to_contact.description: Must be true: the requester agrees we may contact them about this request. A request without it is refused. Required.

notes.description: Anything that fits nowhere else, free text up to 2000 characters. Optional.

scheduled_class_id.description: UUID of the scheduled class being requested. Class type only: a class request has exactly one of scheduled_class_id or no_class_fits. The class must exist (class_not_found) and be enrolling (class_closed), and attendee_count must not exceed its maximum capacity (over_capacity).

no_class_fits.description: Must be true when present. Class type only: "I would like to be part of a class, none of yours work; tell me when one is available." Excludes scheduled_class_id. A demand signal, especially with dates, time and location filled in.

has_minors_present.description: Whether anyone under 18 will be on site. Required, true or false. Must be true when any listed person is a child or teen. Vital information for later planning.

requester_age_band.description: Age group of the requester: child, teen or adult. Optional (the pages do not ask it today).

organization_name.description: A club, company, church or nonprofit the request is on behalf of. Optional, any type.

group_type.description: What kind of group this is: family, friends, colleagues, club_or_nonprofit or other. Group type only; optional.

needs_invoice.description: True when an organization needs an invoice or purchase order instead of paying by card.

venue_arrangement.description: Who arranges the space for a private or group session: we_have_space (the requester has a place) or need_suggestion (please suggest one). Optional; not allowed on a class request.

sessions_requested.description: How many sessions the requester wants, for a series (1 to 52). Optional; not allowed on a class request.

id.description: UUID v4, set by the server; also the Firestore document id. Never sent by the browser.

schema_version.description: Version of this schema the record was written under (currently 1). Set by the server.

created_at.description: When the record was created (UTC, ISO 8601). Set by the server.

created_by.description: Who created the record, as an actor string: web:enjoy for the public pages, system:<handler>, user:<uuid>. Set by the server.

updated_at.description: When the record last changed (UTC). Set by the server.

updated_by.description: Who last changed the record, as an actor string. Set by the server.

source.description: Where the record came from: web_enjoy (the public pages), dashboard or import. Set by the server.

previous_id.description: When the same normalized email already had a request of the same type, the id of the earlier record. A flag, never a refusal: repeats are saved as new records. Set by the server.

deleted_at.description: Soft-delete time. A deleted record is kept but ignored. Set by the server.

deleted_by.description: Actor who soft-deleted the record. Set by the server.

confirmation_number.description: The reference shown to the visitor, ICDT- followed by six characters (no vowels, no 0 or 1, so it reads cleanly and is hard to guess). Set by the server.

processing_status.description: Where the request is in processing: not_processed (always at creation), partially_processed or processed. Set by the server and later by handlers.

processed_at.description: When processing finished. Set by a handler, never by the browser.

is_paid.description: Whether a payment is tied to this request. False at creation. Never store card or other payment details; this is only a flag plus the source and id below.

payment_source.description: Which payment system recorded the payment (for example a third-party processor). Set by a handler. Never card details.

payment_id.description: The payment event's id in that system. Set by a handler. Never card details.

class_registered_at_request.description: Snapshot: how many people were registered in the class when this request arrived. Present only when a class was picked. Set by the server.

seats_available_at_request.description: Snapshot: seats left up to the class maximum when this request arrived (never below 0). Present only when a class was picked. Set by the server.

class_capacity_target_at_request.description: Snapshot: the class's target capacity when this request arrived. Present only when a class was picked. Set by the server.

class_capacity_max_at_request.description: Snapshot: the class's absolute maximum capacity when this request arrived. Present only when a class was picked. Set by the server.
